seed.name: Loop Hunter
seed.text: Sample. Four rounds, a "quick" case, then a panel that had not read the doc. If your loop needs a map, it is already a no.

seed.name: Inbox Filter
seed.text: Sample. Recruiter spam of the week: senior IC role, "must be in office," salary "competitive," company I left two years ago. Delete is a skill.

seed.name: Offer Clock
seed.text: Sample. Verbal Friday. "Paper is coming Monday." It is Wednesday. The silence is doing more talking than the HM.

seed.name: Floor Note
seed.text: Sample. This is the room, not the funnel. Nobody here is going to polish your résumé for a fee. Talk the job. Talk the loop. Leave the ATS energy at the door.

seed.name: Panel Ghost
seed.text: Sample. Onsite was six people. Two asked the same system-design prompt. One asked "where do you see yourself" like it was 2014. Still waiting on the debrief.

seed.name: Recruiter Tea
seed.text: Sample. Agency ping at 7am: "urgent req, 3 years experience, 10 years preferred, $20k under market, start next week." I archived it with feeling.

seed.name: Band Talk
seed.text: Sample. They said the band is "wide." Wide enough to hide the number until after you fly. Ask for the range in the first screen. Dummy advice, real habit.

seed.name: Referral Desk
seed.text: Sample. Warm intro landed. Recruiter replied in nine minutes. Process still took six weeks. Speed of the first email is not speed of the offer.
